load_camembert_pretrained: load a pretrained CamemBERT French language model using CamembertModel.from_pretrained with a model name or path
get_camembert_hub_models: get the available CamemBERT hub model variants and their download URLs via CamembertModel.hub_models
encode_french_sentence: encode a French sentence into BPE token IDs using the RobertaHubInterface encode method
decode_french_tokens: decode BPE token IDs back into a French sentence using the RobertaHubInterface decode method
review_camembert_model: review the CamembertModel class which extends RobertaModel for French NLP tasks with pretrained model support
